# Midwest Hebrew Ministries

> Midwest Hebrew Ministries is an independent ministry founded in 1939 by Rev. V.L. Peterson, Mrs. Julia Solverude-Knutson and a board of directors, with the goal of sharing the message with Jewish people that Yeshua is the long-awaited Messiah (Romans 1:16). Today it is led by Tov Rose (president) and Michelle Rose, headquartered at 10701 College Ave, Kansas City, MO 64137-1742, phone 651-686-5600, email admin@midwesthebrewministries.com.

## Pages

- [Home](https://midwesthebrewministries.com/): Ministry overview, Psalm 103:12 hero, featured ministries, Romans 1:16 banner, newsletter signup.
- [Shalom!](https://midwesthebrewministries.com/shalom/): "Shalom Y'all!" — the ministry's greeting article: peace in a world of wars and rumors of wars, centered on Yeshua the Messiah.
- [About MHM](https://midwesthebrewministries.com/about/): The 1939 founding story, the Romans 1:16 mandate, and the ministry today.
- [Ministries We Sponsor](https://midwesthebrewministries.com/ministries/): Current ministries — Call to Return Ministries and the NMV Bible Project — plus a heritage section preserving the ministries sponsored on the 2016-2017 site (Tikvat Yisrael School / Hope of Israel School, Gospel Cafe Ministries, Humble Cup Coffee Shop).
- [Events](https://midwesthebrewministries.com/events/): Conferences and Tours & Missions overview.
- [Conferences](https://midwesthebrewministries.com/events/conferences/): Teaching conferences on the Jewish roots of the faith.
- [Tours & Missions](https://midwesthebrewministries.com/events/tours-missions/): Israel tours and missions trips.
- [Testimonies](https://midwesthebrewministries.com/testimonies/): Testimonies of the gospel's power (Romans 1:16) and how to share one.
- [Blog](https://midwesthebrewministries.com/blog/): Ministry writing, beginning with the restored "Shalom Y'all!" article.
- [Media](https://midwesthebrewministries.com/media/): Video, audio, and photos from the ministry.
- [Video](https://midwesthebrewministries.com/media/video/): Video teachings, published on YouTube (@tovrose).
- [Audio](https://midwesthebrewministries.com/media/audio/): Audio teachings (library being rebuilt).
- [Photos](https://midwesthebrewministries.com/media/photos/): Photos from tours and gatherings (library being rebuilt).
- [Newsletter](https://midwesthebrewministries.com/newsletter/): Email newsletter signup — ministry news, events, prayer updates.
- [Contact](https://midwesthebrewministries.com/contact/): Address, phone, email, contact form, and donate link.

## Key facts

- Founded: 1939. Founders: Rev. V.L. Peterson, Mrs. Julia Solverude-Knutson, and a board of directors.
- Mandate verse: Romans 1:16 — "first to the Jew, then to the Gentile."
- Sub-organizations: Call to Return Ministries; NMV Bible Project (NMV Bible Project & Foundation, https://nmvbible.org/ — the New Messianic Version Bible translation).
- Donate: https://www.zeffy.com/en-US/donation-form/bring-the-word-home-end-of-year-giving-campaign
